reason: Automatically enriches unconfigured DeepSeek Harness llm-pi-ai models with reasoning levels sourced from models.dev, while preserving existing reasoningEfforts settings.

summaries.zh: 从 models.dev 自动补齐 DeepSeek Harness 中尚未配置 reasoningEfforts 的 llm-pi-ai 模型推理档位，并保留已有配置。
summaries.en: Automatically fills reasoning levels for DeepSeek Harness llm-pi-ai models lacking reasoningEfforts settings, while preserving existing configurations.

capabilities: Reads model metadata from models.dev over HTTPS
Falls back to a models.dev GitHub tarball when the API request fails
Writes missing reasoningEfforts settings under llm-pi-ai
Caches downloaded data in the system temporary directory
